features.name: Foundation: First Strike
features.description: The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack roll, double the damage of the attack.

features.name: Foundation: Ambush
features.description: Your Marked for Death feature uses d6s instead of d4s.

features.name: Specialization: Death Strike
features.description: When you deal Severe damage to a creature, you can mark a Stress to make them mark an additional Hit Point.

features.name: Specialization: Scorpion's Poise
features.description: You gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against any attacks made by a creature Marked for Death.

features.name: Mastery: True Strike
features.description: Once per long rest, when you fail an attack roll, you can spend a Hope to make it a success instead.

features.name: Mastery: Backstab
features.description: Your Marked for Death feature uses d8s instead of d6s.
